rows.text: board revises the price of a **preferential issue of 7,06,068 shares at Rs 560.13 and Rs 558.99 to be paid as non-cash consideration for 51% of Matrix Labs Diagnocare** and a stake in Matrix Labs, rather than for money.

executes share purchase agreements for **51% each of Matrix Labs Diagnocare and Matrix Labs, Rs 35,97,81,800 and Rs 3,56,35,320**, discharged entirely in 7,14,680 of its own shares at Rs 553 — **Rs 39,54,17,120 of non-cash consideration** to Suresh and Nithya S.

issues **shares at Rs 553 aggregating Rs 39,54,17,120 to buy 51% each of Matrix Labs Diagnocare (Rs 35,97,81,800) and Matrix Labs (Rs 3,56,35,320)** from Suresh and Nithya S, the SPAs signed today. The money goes OUT: its own shares are the acquisition currency. Subject to members, AGM 29 September.
